name: travel-planner
description: Travel Planner - A photography-led travel discovery and planning app

scripts.build: pnpm --filter mobile build && pnpm --filter api build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter mobile lint && pnpm --filter api lint && pnpm --filter shared lint && pnpm --filter config lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter mobile typecheck && pnpm --filter api typecheck && pnpm --filter shared typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter mobile test && pnpm --filter api test && pnpm --filter shared test
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter mobile test:unit && pnpm --filter api test:unit && pnpm --filter shared test:unit
